claims.text: Routine antibiotic drops are unnecessary; prophylactic drops if contaminants may have entered through the perforation
claims.quote: Routine antibiotic ear drops are unnecessary. However, prophylaxis with antibiotic ear drops is necessary if contaminants may have entered through the perforation.

claims.text: If the ear becomes infected, fluoroquinolone drops (ciprofloxacin or ofloxacin) alone are usually enough
claims.quote: If the ear becomes infected, amoxicillin (eg, 500 mg orally every 8 hours for 7 days) can be given, however, topical therapy with fluoroquinolone ear drops (ciprofloxacin or ofloxacin) alone is typically sufficient.
